welcome.title: Hi, I am your Lilo guide
welcome.body: I will show you around. What do you want to make first? You can skip me at any time, and bring me back from Help.

choices.label: Stitch a picture
choices.hint: Turn a logo or sketch into stitches, like the Kadwood hibiscus.

choices.label: Draw from scratch
choices.hint: Draw a shape, like a crest or a hat patch.

choices.label: Type a monogram
choices.hint: Sew initials, like JK inside a suit lining.

choices.label: Open a file
choices.hint: Carry on with a project you already saved.

steps.title: Choose your picture
steps.body: Click here and pick a logo or drawing. Flat colours work best. I will wait for it to finish.

steps.title: How many colours?
steps.body: Fewer colours mean fewer thread swaps. Try a lower number, then press Digitize again.

steps.title: Set the size
steps.body: Type a width in millimetres. A logo on a suit lining is often 40 to 80 mm wide.

steps.title: What are you sewing on?
steps.body: Open this card and pick your fabric, thread weight and quality. Lilo tunes the stitches to match.

steps.title: Check the hoop
steps.body: The hoop is the frame that holds the cloth. Your design must fit inside it. Click here to change it.

steps.title: Watch it sew
steps.body: Press Play. The needle sews the design on screen and stops at each colour change.

steps.title: Your progress
steps.body: These five steps tick themselves off. Click one for a tip.

steps.title: Send or export
steps.body: Send goes to a Brother or Baby Lock machine over Wi-Fi. Export saves a file for a USB stick. Open either.

steps.title: Start a blank design
steps.body: Click New design to open an empty hoop.

steps.title: Pick a shape tool
steps.body: Closed shape draws an outline that fills in. Click it, or press 2.

steps.title: Draw a shape
steps.body: Click to add corners. Click the first point, or press Enter, to close it.

steps.title: Change how it sews
steps.body: Pick filled or outlined, a fill pattern, or the run type. Every change shows at once.

steps.title: Check the hoop
steps.body: Make sure your shape fits the hoop. Click here to pick a different one.

steps.title: Watch it sew
steps.body: Press Play to see your shape stitched.

steps.title: Send or export
steps.body: Send over Wi-Fi, or Export a file for a USB stick. Open either.

steps.title: Start a monogram
steps.body: Click here to open a blank design with the Text tool ready.

steps.title: Choose the spot
steps.body: Click on the canvas where the initials should sit.

steps.title: Type your initials
steps.body: Two or three letters, like JK, make a neat lining mark.

steps.title: Set the height
steps.body: Letters under 6 mm fill in with standard thread. 10 mm is a good size for a lining monogram.

steps.title: Pick a font
steps.body: These fonts were drawn to be sewn. Keep the box ticked to see only fonts that suit your height.

steps.title: Add it
steps.body: Press Add text. The letters appear on the canvas as stitches.

steps.title: Watch it sew
steps.body: Press Play to see the letters stitched.

steps.title: Send or export
steps.body: Send over Wi-Fi, or Export a file for a USB stick. Open either.

steps.title: Open your project
steps.body: Click Open and choose a .lilo project. Recent projects are listed further down.

steps.title: Look it over
steps.body: Your design is on the canvas. Scroll to zoom, hold Space and drag to pan.

steps.title: Check the hoop
steps.body: Make sure the design fits the hoop on your machine.

steps.title: Check the sewing setup
steps.body: Open this card to confirm the fabric and thread weight still match your job.

steps.title: Check the order
steps.body: The Layers tab is your sewing order. The bottom layer sews first and the top layer sews last. Drag layers and shapes to change it.

steps.title: Watch it sew
steps.body: Press Play to see the whole design stitched.

steps.title: Send or export
steps.body: Send over Wi-Fi, or Export a file for a USB stick. Open either.

done.title: You are all set
done.body: You can replay this tour any time from Help. Have a look at the guide when you want more.
